<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

The installer, built as ONE declarative matrix over four write strategies — the authoritative design is assets/workshops/hooks-installing.md and it is the product of a source raid on git-ai's 15 bespoke installers. ORDERING IS DELIBERATE: Strategy A (7 agents, INCLUDING CURSOR) is the critical path because Cursor is the agent the end-to-end validation actually runs against. Strategies C and D come last so they are the natural cut line if time runs short — cutting breadth is acceptable, cutting the safety properties is not. TWO THINGS ALREADY MEASURED AND EASY TO GET WRONG: (1) we ALREADY have an agent-config backup mechanism in services/doctor/collector/backup.ts writing ~/.git-ai/harness-backups/<iso>/ — REUSE it, a second backup path makes restore ambiguous; (2) the live hook on this machine points into untracked scratch/, so `status` must STAT its configured target rather than report that a config entry exists — an entry pointing at a deleted file is indistinguishable from a working hook, which is this plan's own silent-failure class reintroduced from the installer side.
